name: lance_file::writer::writer_tests::tests::test_read_unequal_length_projection
behavior: Async projection test uses V2_0/V2_1 and roots a,b,c. Documentation claims bounded reads are valid when every projected column covers the range, but the later explicit common-prefix assertion rejects unequal-length projected roots; preserve this contradiction. No summary assertion here; these unequal lengths drive the projection oracle. Local read closure constructs projection then returns either an opening error or a try_collect error in the same Result<Vec<RecordBatch>>. Thus callers cannot distinguish an upfront failure from one encountered while collecting. col_values downcasts chosen Int32 column in each batch and allocates nullable value vectors. Single-column c RangeFull returns[100], a RangeFull returns1..5. a RangeFrom2 returns3..5, c RangeFrom0 returns100, a RangeTo3 returns1..3. a RangeTo6 and c RangeFrom2 must error, with no variant/text or equality-at-end case. name: lance_file::writer::writer_tests::tests::test_compression_overrides_end_to_end
behavior: Compression override test uses V2_1 and five nonnullable fields customer_id,product_id,quantity:Int32;price:Float32;description:Utf8. Builder setup/comments propose repetitions, randomness and long Zstd strings, but actual following fixture and configured overrides are narrower. For10,000 rows customer_id=i/100 gives100 runs, product_id=i/2000 gives5 runs, quantity is5 every10th row else1 (deterministic, not random), price cycles9.99/19.99/29.99, description is Product N for5 groups (not a long string). Materialize complete arrays/batch. CompressionParams adds only wildcard *_id with rle_threshold0.5, BSS Off, compression/level/minichunk absent. Comments explicitly skip Zstd. max_page_bytes=64KiB. No matching-precedence test or compression-ratio assertion follows. Write configured V2_1 file, add compression_test=configured_compression, finish; separately write same batch with default compression options and same64KiB page cap. Variable names say no_compression, but no override means defaults, not globally disabled compression. Baseline is never opened or compared; comment allowing larger compressed size is not a measured size assertion. Open configured file, assert exact metadata versionV2_1 and schema key/value. Comment says verify data integrity, but no data stream is decoded anywhere in this test. Default comparison file does not participate in these assertions.
